rf_contract.reset_basis: All inputs predate checkpoint v25 and end at an exact RF boundary; no prior diagnostic blocks are imported into the new epoch.

adaptive_equilibration.termination: Stop a seed only at a completed 32-cycle block when every observable passes every gate, or classify the seed as horizon-exhausted after 64 new blocks.
adaptive_equilibration.cross_seed_gate: All three seeds must independently converge before profile confirmation begins.

post_equilibration_measurement.published_comparison: Apply the existing Turner comparator to every post-equilibration block descriptively and to the preregistered pooled stationary profile for the formal side-by-side result.

decision_rule.sampling_readiness_failed: Any seed exhausts 64 adaptive blocks without passing every online gate.
decision_rule.slow_mode_resolved_toward_reference: All online and profile-stationarity gates pass, the absolute pooled integrated-density bias is at most 1 percent, and the range among seed-mean biases is at most 1 percentage point.
decision_rule.stationary_persistent_model_bias_support: All online and profile-stationarity gates pass, every seed-mean bias has the same sign, and the absolute pooled integrated-density bias exceeds 1 percent.
decision_rule.mixed_stationary_outcome: All stationarity gates pass but neither resolved nor persistent-bias conditions hold.

repair_policy: Do not tune collision rates, cross sections, particle weights, boundary physics, or statistical thresholds during this campaign. A stationary persistent bias authorizes a separate algorithm-mismatch audit, not an agreement-seeking parameter change.
claim_boundary: The online controller establishes internal sampling readiness from phase-consistent global observables. Formal Turner profile evidence additionally requires the locked post-equilibration spatial measurement stage. Neither stage alone validates other plasma regimes.
